text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — latency spike and queue growth observed on prod-global runtime (chat + embeddings). Error rate slightly up, customers reporting timeouts. Investigating.

alex: seeing queue depth climb on region-us-west-2, p95 tail latencies up to 2.1s for short prompts. Inflight count at ~820 (target 600).

morgan: confirm — autoscaler isn't adding capacity because slice quotas hit. Some tenants at max-inflight.

anya: tagging oncall. @oncall-bot please rotate to current oncall.

oncall-bot: @morgan, @alex assigned as primary responders for this pager. Please post mitigation plan.

alex: initial mitigation plan: 1) reduce global max-inflight to 500 for non-critical slices (soft cap) 2) enable soft-shedding for embeddings-heavy tenants 3) bump reserved quota for a small set of affected enterprise tenants (manual) 4) temporarily disable reranking/long-context feature for free tier to free KV cache.

jordan: sounds good. I'll push the soft-cap change. Applying soft-cap:

```bash
# set soft max-inflight for runtime slices
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/runtime/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN' -d '{"slice_selector":"tier:default","max_inflight_soft":500}'
```

maria: I'll handle tenant-level bumps. Which tenant IDs? Alex, list top 3 customers seeing timeouts.

alex: top impacted from logs: tenant_48 (prod-search), tenant_91 (analytics), tenant_12 (genai-saas). Please bump tenant_48 and tenant_91 delta +100 inflight and mark tenant_12 for observation only.

maria: done for tenant_48 and tenant_91. Applied commit id: cfg-2024-887b. Notifying account owners.

phil: I'll flip soft-shedding for embeddings-heavy ops. Command:

```json
{"action":"enable_soft_shed","selector":"feature:embeddings AND tier:free","threshold_pct":85}
```

phil: executed. Starting to see queue drain on those slices.

morgan: notice p95 for chat back to ~700ms after the soft-shed, queue length trending down. However there are still long-running KV-cache hits causing holds. Propose decreasing request timeout from 30s -> 12s for non-enterprise tenants to avoid head-of-line blocking.

anya: agree. That will shed long tail and improve throughput. We'll apply a temporary route override.

alex: applying route-level timeout tweak now (non-enterprise):

```bash
# update route override
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/routes/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","tenant_filter":"tier:free,trial","timeout_ms":12000}'
```

alex: done. Monitoring.

maria: customer comms: tenant_48 and tenant_91 notified via support ticket. Mentioned we're applying temporary quota bump and degrading non-essential features.

jordan: telemetry shows inflight down to ~490 across most slices, global p95 now ~380ms. Some error-rate spikes persist for tenant_12 — they're running large-batched embed requests.

phil: for tenant_12 I recommend disabling batch-merge for embeddings on their slice and pinning them to smaller batch size (16). I'll submit patch:

```yaml
- tenant: tenant_12
  embeddings:
    batch_size: 16
    batch_merge: false
```

phil: patch applied.

morgan: good stabilization. Next: plan to rollback temporary mitigations once stable for 15m. Who will own rollback?

alex: I'll own the soft-cap rollback and timeout rollback. Maria can revert tenant bumps after confirmation from accounts. Phil will revert shedders/batch changes.

oncall-bot: escalation checklist: if latency not under target in 10m, escalate to infra-sre and consider spinning new GPU pool (dedicated) or routing to fallback model variant.

anya: quick customer-impact summary for comms channel: 1) visible timeouts for some free/trial customers 2) degraded embeddings quality for free tier due to temporary soft-shedding and smaller batch sizes 3) enterprise tenants with bumps should see normal behavior 4) we're monitoring and will update in 15m.

maria: putting a short note in status page: "Partial mitigation in place — temporary limits and feature degradations applied to reduce latency. Affected customers contacted."

jordan: 15m check-in: p95 stable ~360ms, error-rate normalized to baseline for bumped tenants, free-tier timeouts down by 80%. Queue steady. Recommend start rollback sequence in 10m if stable.

alex: starting rollback of route timeout to 30s for non-enterprise in 10m. Will coordinate with Maria and Phil.

phil: preparing revert commands.

maria: will keep account owners updated and close the loop once mitigations fully rolled back.

anya: thanks team. Please keep thread updated with any regressions. Filing incident ticket 2024-RT-145 to track actions and postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident 2024-RT-145 created and linked. Severity: P3. Assigned to alex, morgan.

alex: marking this thread resolved for live mitigation — continuing follow-up in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
